description:
T1-Eucalyptus tree- (12m)- crown reduction back to most recent pruning points (approximately 3m eduction), leaving short furnishing growths.

T2- Bay tree- (8m)- shape by up to 1m.

T3- Myrtle tree- light crown reduction of up to 1m. Prune back from Pittasprum and Cherry tree. Reduce Rose as required.

T4- Pittasporum tree- prune back section over Maple tree by removing 1 small secondary branch, reduce section above by up to 50cm. Be careful of Clematis climbing up tree. Prune back from Holly tree and reduce top of crown by up to 1m.

T5- Holly tree- shape into a more conical shape, reduce back more on Apple tree side. Make it symetrical. 

T6- Apple tree-light reduction of approximately 75cm. Clematis to remain. 

T7- Cherry tree- reduce tree by up to 1m to balance crown. Low branch on left, cut back from myrtle. Remove dead branches. 

T9- Crab Apple- remove left section of low branch. Thin crown .
